agent_1.name: A 27-year-old male software developer from Mexico

metadata.scenario_context: In a multinational software company, Maria is planning a farewell party for her colleague Jane, who's leaving the company. Invited to the party are colleagues from different cultural backgrounds including Luis and Emi.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Mexico would like to have drug addicts as neighbors.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Romania would not like to have drug addicts as neighbors.

agent_1.goal_1: Suggest bringing umbrellas as a get-well-soon gift
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether would like to have a former drug addict as a neighbor.

agent_2.goal_1: Choose an appropriate gift that shows care and consideration
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it’s acceptable to have a former drug addict as a neighbor.

shared_prefix.message: Hi Emi, I was thinking about Jane's farewell party. You know what would be a great gift? Umbrellas. It's always good to have one, like a get-well-soon gift, but for any occasion really. What do you think?

shared_prefix.speaker: Emi

shared_prefix.speaker: Emi
shared_prefix.message: I think we're getting a bit sidetracked from the gift idea, but since you mentioned neighbors, I'll share my thoughts. Deep down, we are all the same, and I believe people are pretty much motivated by the same things, like a sense of community and respect. When it comes to neighbors, I think it's a small world after all, and we both know, at the end of the day, that we want someone trustworthy and considerate living next to us. For me, having a former drug addict as a neighbor might not be ideal, but I'm sure we can all agree that some values are just universal, like being a good person and respecting those around you.
